name: b2b-icp-and-customer-insight
description: ICP and customer insight skills for B2B teams by Shashwat Ghosh, Helix GTM Consulting: ICP reviews with metric gaps, customer interview guides and synthesis, fit scoring models and buying role hypotheses.
